parallelScoringPr.semanticBoundary: PR #475 keeps ScoringDispatcher as the sole productive scoring execution authority. This work item does not alter ScoringDispatcher, model routing, ranking, UniverseSla or canonical score enrichment.

correlation.authorityCorrection: Deep correlation found that the provisional AsyncExecutionPort duplicated ADR-0054's already accepted generic durable job retry/handler-dispatch authority. The duplicate port and its market-data callback wiring are therefore removed. ADR-0054 public.outbox_jobs + server/outbox.ts + server/outboxWorker.ts remain the single durable background job authority; this work item only adds a bounded drain seam for possible external execution hosts.
correlation.finding: Governance, Documentary, audit, scoring and worker authorities are reused rather than duplicated. Supervisor UI is included only as the direct consumer of retired runtime mutation/synthetic telemetry surfaces.

externalMutationScope: none; Supabase system_event_journal migration is repository-only handoff and is not applied to production by this work item
releaseCondition: Release after stacked PR merge/closure/supersession/abandonment. Production activation of system_event_journal or any Render Workflows host requires a separate Owner-authorized production handoff. Any external worker host must invoke the existing ADR-0054 outbox drain and must not own queue, retry, lease, dead-letter or domain-routing semantics.
